name: The drawer after signing out and back in without a reload. Plugin Pages 2.4.7 doesn't add its section again; in Auto mode our "Library tools" links then appear (the drawer-based decision), and in FallbackOnly mode they stay. Needs EnablePageDemo on.

steps.name: drawer open
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = document.querySelector(".mainDrawer .userMenuOptions"); if (!a) return false; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && r.left >= 0 && r.right <= innerWidth && r.top >= 0 && getComputedStyle(a).visibility !== 'hidden'; })()

steps.name: our links before signing out
steps.eval: (() => ({ pluginPagesSection: !!document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .pluginMenuOptions'), pluginPagesLinks: [...document.querySelectorAll('.mainDrawer .pluginMenuOptions a[data-itemid^="Jellyfin.Plugin.Bookmarks"]')].map(a => a.getAttribute('data-itemid')), libraryToolsLinks: [...document.querySelectorAll('.mainDrawer .jfkit-nav a[data-jfkit-plugin="jfbm"]')].map(a => ({ key: a.getAttribute('data-jfbm-nav'), href: a.getAttribute('href') })) }))()

steps.name: Sign out visible in the drawer
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = document.querySelector(".mainDrawer .btnLogout"); if (!a) return false; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && r.left >= 0 && r.right <= innerWidth && r.top >= 0 && getComputedStyle(a).visibility !== 'hidden'; })()

drawer open

steps.name: both demo pages still have a link: Plugin Pages' or ours
in Auto mode with Plugin Pages' section gone, the links are ours (the two demo pages, My Bookmarks and My Clips)
click our Demo page A link
Demo page A renders
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll(" [data-jfbm-page=\"demo-a\"][data-jfbm-mounted]")].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); const t = (document.querySelector('.skinHeader .pageTitle') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.trim(); const title = r && r.querySelector('.jfbm-demo-title'); const user = r && r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-demo="user"]'); if (!r || !title || title.textContent !== "Demo page A" || [...document.querySelectorAll('#fallbackPage > :not([data-jfbm-page]) h1')].some(h => h.getClientRects().length > 0) || t !== "Demo page A" || !user || user.textContent === '…') return false;  return { hash: location.hash, render: Number(r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-render')), reason: r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-reason'), host: r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-host'), params: JSON.parse(r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-demo="params"]').textContent), user: user.textContent, admin: r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-demo="admin"]').textContent, headerTitle: t, documentTitle: document.title, historyLength: history.length }; })()
